collection.title: Audi A8 Integrated Washer Jets 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A8 2018 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button Fitting arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. PLEASE NOTE: A728S is specifically designed for models with the Integrated Washer Jets.
